newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends down,seen falling to new lows.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends down,seen falling to new lows.

text.p: The Philippine peso slid to new lows on Monday as importers snapped up dollars ahead of a further slide in the currency, traders said.
"Local banks that have big importers were buying up the dollar," a trader said.

The peso ended at 30.14 to dollar but this was up from the record low of 30.24 reached in afternoon deals. It closed at 29.80 the previous day. Volume was higher at $119.3 million compared with $103.9 million.
